why: Universes at 0. A's forms of Proposition 9.2.15 (1) and (3), the local formula boundaryTheta_eq, isFunctorial_boundaryTheta and filter_tangentValue_eq all take hind : HasIndependentTangentSums Θ, i.e. Theorem 9.2.1's claim that ∑ σᵢ T_xMᵢ does not depend on the local branching structure. B claims (1)–(3) for every branched ep⁺-subgroupoid without it. Only (2) holds without hind (proposition_9_2_15_2). With hind added to B's hypotheses (BInd), A ⇒ BInd is proved, with F = ∂Θ (A_to_BInd). hind is satisfiable: indicators, Θ = 1 on [0, ∞), and every Θ on ℝⁿ (hasIndependentTangentSums_rn). It is the content of the text's Theorem 9.2.1, which the project proves only in special cases: good points, ℝⁿ, the equidimensional case with tangent slices, or from Proposition 9.1.12, which is stated but not proved. So A ⇒ B is believed true. Proving it would need Theorem 9.2.1 in general, which is substantial mathematics; the gap is not a difference of reading. B ⇒ A: from B (3), B's F agrees with every local sum at the points of supp Θ and vanishes off supp Θ, so F = ∂Θ. This gives functoriality, nonnegativity and supp ∂Θ ⊆ ∂X. The other conjuncts (mem_submanifoldBoundary_iff, the local formula, 9.2.15 (1), (2), filter_tangentValue_eq) are stated for arbitrary Θ and x, which B does not cover. They are re-proved outright as copies of the project's proofs.
